Unguarded `Optional.get()` will throw `NoSuchElementException` - `credentialModelOpt.get()` is called without checking whether the Optional is present, which will throw NoSuchElementException and surface as a 500 error instead of a graceful redirect or error page
Typo in config alias: "suthenticator" should be "authenticator" in "delayed-suthenticator-config"

`getCredentials` loses the stored credential ID, causing silent removal failure - `RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel.createFromValues(...)` generates a fresh, random ID for the returned model instead of using the original ID, so when `removeStoredCredentialById` is called it will not match any stored credential and the removal silently no-ops
